review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines one object, `finiteTypeSpecialization`, which is a quotient in the TauCeti-local category `FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat`. It also has an isomorphism to the `SL_{r+1}` coordinate algebra, two simp lemmas, and a reductivity transport theorem. I grepped Mathlib for `FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat` and `reductiveCommHopfAlgProperty` and found no matches. The finite-type category is defined in TauCeti as an object property, `finiteTypeCommHopfAlgProperty`, in `TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/FiniteType/CommHopfAlgCat.lean`. The file builds on that category and does not introduce a competing version of a Mathlib concept. The isomorphism is built with `ObjectProperty.isoMk` and `eqToIso`. The `_obj` and `_hom_hom` simp lemmas are small API lemmas, not duplicated concepts. I saw no justified finding, though I did not read the upstream TauCeti files in full.
